d: The Knicks defeated the Bulls, 135-105 tonight in New York. Jalen Brunson contributed a team-high 33 points to go with 5 three pointers 4 assists and 2 rebounds, with OG Anunoby of the Knicks adding an additional 18 points (3-10 FG, 1-6 3P), 5 rebounds, and 3 stealsin the game. Tre Jones finished with a team-high 14 points along with 4 assists for the Bulls in the losing effort. The Knicks improve their record to 4-4 with the win, while the Bulls fall to 1-7 for the season.
